svg.title: phil@github: neofetch and an accessibility scan
svg.desc: Animated terminal. Running neofetch shows a green pixel-art tree next to: Name Phil Linley, based in Columbus, OH, stack Vue/Nuxt, React/Next.js and Sanity, tests Vitest and Playwright, studio lorienweb.com, sites Dragonfly Bookshop and Hope Church, status open to roles. Then an axe-core scan of lorienweb.com and hopechurchcolumbus.org finds 0 violations on both and reminds that manual testing is always required, and a comment reads: now unplug the mouse and turn on VoiceOver.

text.tspan: ... please wait, this may take a minute.
... please wait, this may take a minute.
Manual testing is always required. For more information see:
# now unplug the mouse and turn on VoiceOver
